description: Arm A. MoE padding cost as a real deployment actually pays it: the stock default. Straddles the 512/1024 token bucket edge so padded work roughly doubles while real work moves ~1.6%, isolating per-padded-token cost rather than inferring it from a throughput difference.
note_seq_len: Per-sequence length is near-constant within an edge (128 vs 130) on purpose. Comparing 4x96 against 4x128 would move sequence length by a third, changing attention work materially and destroying the clean prediction that cost is proportional to real tokens.
note_single_step: Both edges sit far below max_num_batched_tokens=8192 so the scheduler has no reason to split. Every dispatch records its step count and splits are counted, not averaged over: a split reintroduces exactly the smearing this experiment exists to avoid.
note_prediction: REGISTERED. The paid share is a ratio, (measured - real)/(padded - real), and padded tokens route to experts exactly as real tokens do, so if MoE changes cost per token it changes numerator and denominator together. We predict the paid share is unchanged between these two arms within the interval the edge supports. A difference would mean routing treats padded and real tokens differently, which no part of the mechanism in §4.2 anticipates.
prediction_mechanism: Target: the share of nominal padding paid at a compiled boundary. Lever: the straddle, which doubles padded tokens while holding real tokens near-fixed, so d(padded)/d(lever) is 2x and d(real)/d(lever) ~ 1 — the two models the experiment separates predict different costs by construction.
note_model: MoE arm. 30.5B total, ~3B active, Qwen3MoeForCausalLM. The only mixture-of-experts model that is both in tpu-inference's JAX registry and small enough for a v5litepod-4: gpt-oss-20b fits but fails TP=4 sharding, Llama-4-Scout is 217 GB, DeepSeek-V3 is 685 GB, and DeepSeek-V2-Lite, deepseek-moe-16b, Qwen1.5-MoE and OLMoE are architectures the registry does not accept.
note_confounds: Not fully matched: the MoE arm is GQA 8:1 with 48 layers, the dense arm GQA 4:1 with 36 layers. Those affect attention cost, while the paid share concerns token padding in a matmul-dominated prefill step, so they are expected to bias little; they are stated rather than corrected because no smaller Qwen3 MoE exists.

independent_vars.tensor_parallel_size: gpt-oss-20b is MXFP4; 2880/4=720 is not 32-aligned so a 4-bit block would straddle two chips at the paper's TP=4. TP=2 gives 1440=45*32. The dense control moves to TP=2 as well so MoE-vs-dense is not confounded with TP.
independent_vars.MOE_ROUTE_PADDING_TO_EXPERT0: The independent variable of the A/B: tpu-inference ships this False, so the stock default dispatches padding tokens to k real experts.
